description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger from step 4, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger from step 2, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth.
When Luminous Broodmoth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from steps 1 and 12.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Luminous Broodmoth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Luminous Broodmoth enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
